source.original_title: 05/14/2026 - Danny Es & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/14/2026 - Danny Es & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Follow Up

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: Rep opens by quoting her handover directly: 'Kim told me you want to get the fittest you've ever been.'

prospect.name: Danny Es
prospect.location: Ventura County, Los Angeles area, California, USA
prospect.family_status: Married; wife works and finishes at 5pm. Has children who play soccer and basketball, with games at weekends.
prospect.training_background: Consistent gym-goer for about eighteen months, lifting four days a week — compounds at six to eight reps plus hypertrophy work at ten to twelve — with fifteen to twenty minutes of cardio when time allows. Lost roughly 60 lb over that period and gained muscle. Rates his current condition 6-7 out of 10 against a peak in his twenties. Also does push-ups, pull-ups and burpees. Has never used a kettlebell.
prospect.medical: No conditions, diagnoses or treatment disclosed. Reports age-related recovery complaints from heavy lifting: body aching the next day and difficulty sleeping after hard sessions, which he attributes to raised cortisol. Concerned about joint and bone wear from continuing to lift heavy.

signals: Already succeeding independently — down about 60 lb in eighteen months and satisfied with it: 'I think I look decent for the amount of work I put in in a year and a half'
Explicitly framing the buy as good to great: rates himself 6-7 against a 10-out-of-10 peak and wants 'an athletic superhero physique kind of guy'
Price read as a quality decision rather than a barrier — on hearing $6,000 and $9,000 he immediately leaned to the more expensive tier: 'I'll probably go with the $9,000 one'
Buying efficiency rather than rescue: 'It's time efficient... You don't have to be at the gym for an hour, an hour and a half'
No crisis, no injury history, no failed-attempts pattern — the only friction is time and the last bit of abdominal fat

goals.text: Get shredded — the last of the abdominal fat is the outstanding piece after a 60 lb loss
Reach an athletic superhero physique — his own definition of a 10 out of 10
Build more muscle while staying lean and functional
Get the whole thing done in 45 to 60 minutes so it fits around work and his kids' sport
Stay able to move — pull-ups, push-ups, general athleticism — and be able to go out and do things with his kids
Stop wearing out his joints with heavy lifting as he ages, and recover better
Be the fittest he has ever been, past his twenties peak

pains.text: Training block is eating an hour and a half plus a drive, against a schedule of work from home, kids' soccer and basketball and weekend games
Recovery has become hard with age — body aching the next day and difficulty sleeping after heavy sessions
Stuck on the last of the stomach fat despite eighteen months of consistent work
Worried about joint and bone damage from continuing to lift heavy
Has wanted to try kettlebells but has not, held back by not knowing how to do them right
No longer tracks food and has plateaued on a self-managed diet that got him the initial loss

objections.raw_quote: You know, since it's a large investment, then I'm going to talk to my wife. I'll probably go with the $9,000 one, but I've to talk to her since it's a large investment. And then once I have that, I can text you back tonight once she gets home.
objections.rep_response: Accepted it immediately and completely — 'Yeah, it's all good' — then moved to logistics, established the prospect's local time, noted it would be 10pm in London and that he would be asleep, and pushed the follow-up to the next day on WhatsApp. Not one move of the spouse play was attempted.

offer.guarantee_mentioned: 'I forgot to say as well, we guarantee your results. So, the way it works, we guarantee you that from your start in weight of a kettlebell, which will likely be 35 pounds, which is what we'll prescribe for the start in weight. From your start in weight, you will, over a six-month period, be doing eight kilos, which is 20 pounds, roughly. Like, you'll be using a 20-pound heavier kettlebell for every single movement.' Remedy stated as continued coaching, not a refund: 'if for any reason you're not there, we will... Trevor will work with you until you are at that point. So everything is guaranteed.'

evidence: No payment taken and no payment link sent
Decision explicitly deferred to a spouse conversation: 'I've to talk to her since it's a large investment'

Strong counter-evidence toward a close: he pre-selected the higher tier unprompted — 'I'll probably go with the $9,000 one' — and offered to come back the same evening, 'I can text you back tonight once she gets home'
The rep declined the same-day window on timezone grounds ('It's 10 p.m. for me. I will probably be asleep') and moved it to the next day, so no confirmed time exists
The onboarding call with Trevor was proposed for Monday but never booked
Every pillar landed and the prospect summarised the offer back positively: 'To me, it sounds really good. It's time efficient. It's going to give me the results.'
outcome.next_step: Prospect to speak to his wife after 5pm local, then message the rep on WhatsApp on his existing number ending 603; rep to follow up the next day. No time agreed, no deposit, no onboarding call booked.

notable.note: This is the cleanest offer presentation in the batch — only the two sanctioned tiers were quoted, $6,000/6mo and $9,000/12mo, with no discounting and no improvised terms. It is also the most expensive miss. The prospect volunteered the larger package, offered to confirm within three hours, and the rep ran none of the spouse play and then pushed the follow-up out a day because of the time difference. Separately, the results guarantee was stated here with a remedy attached (Trevor keeps working with you) where on the Moath call a day earlier it was stated with no remedy at all, and it includes prescribing a 35 lb starting bell to a 46-year-old who has never held a kettlebell.

quality.notes: Severe and sustained. The labels invert for long stretches: the whole offer walkthrough from 00:07:45 to 00:08:30 is attributed to 'Danny' but is plainly the rep ('everything's tailored around mobility, kettlebells and nutrition'), while the prospect's questions inside it ('How long are the workouts for usually?') are labelled Harry. At 00:12:39-00:13:11 the rep's calisthenics and scoliosis history is split across both labels. The price quote at 00:14:09 is labelled Danny. Roles resolved from content throughout.
